title: Option A finite root interface with state-identity admission pending
authority_scope: Option A preparation is explicitly approved; a complete state-space/enumerator model is not yet approved or defined.

immutable_parent.rule: The parent formulas are incorporated by exact-byte reference, not copied and altered. A new state interpretation is not silently passed off as preservation of the parent counting space.

approved_root_contract.labels: One primitive label per move type, source geometric cell/vertex/edge and sign/direction. Source edge reversal is not a second copy of the same label.
approved_root_contract.duplicates: Distinct labels are retained, including coincident K=2 signs. No averaging or deduplication.
approved_root_contract.invalid: Given an already defined partial map r, omit (x,r) when rx is undefined or outside the fixed state space; do not evaluate F outside that space.
approved_root_contract.identity: A valid rx=x incidence can be retained as a zero-difference row; it adds no off-diagonal state jump.
approved_root_contract.state_rate: q(x,y)=sum_(r admissible at x,rx=y)c_r(x) for y!=x; no division by label counts.
approved_root_contract.root_measure: mu_R(x,r)=pi(x) for each retained directed label; no additional c_r or inverse-pair half weight.
approved_root_contract.adjoint: B* is the adjoint under L2(pi) and the specified root inner product, once both finite state and incidence sets are fixed.
approved_root_contract.balance_caution: Inversion need not preserve pi(x) times root counting. The future balance proof must use the paired conductance pi(x)c_r(x), not assert invariance of the bare root measure.

exact_move_enumerator.reason: Root counting and validity do not determine the partial state maps until the counting-state identity and radial-transfer coordinates are fixed. No all-regulator enumerator has been hash-pinned or used for calculation.

missing_item.question: Are integer coordinate tuples (j_v,ell_v,n_v,u_e), retaining n_v at ell_v=0 and j_v when epsilon=1, with TR changing occupations only and keeping all other coordinates fixed, to be adopted explicitly as the v2 counting-state and transfer convention?
missing_item.why_not_already_approved: Decision v0.1 sections 3 and 4.2 reserve state multiplicity and missing grid/state-map representations. Option A counts root labels, not state labels.
missing_item.source_observation: PAH-001 describes s_v by grid values, psi_v by an amplitude/phase expression and Omega as displayed variables. It does not explicitly state whether coincident parameter labels are distinct counting states. At zero occupation the displayed psi is independent of n; at epsilon=1 the displayed s is independent of the grid index.
missing_item.mathematical_impact: State identification determines counting multiplicities, Z, L2(pi), PH/AP action on null-value labels, and whether occupation transfer retaining phases has a well-defined inverse at a zero-amplitude endpoint. This is a definition choice before the requested finite operator theorem, not an n-uniform estimate.

reference_only_example.role: An existing researcher-successor explicitly makes the tuple/phase-retention choice. Neither that choice nor its finite PASS is imported into v2.

verification_disposition.primary_independent_hostile_mathematics: NOT_RUN: document/provenance admission checks are not mathematical verifiers of a completed model.
verification_disposition.Lean: NOT_RUN: no instantiated state/root domain is available; compiling an abstract conditional identity would not discharge the missing input.

attempt_budget: One bounded exact-source definition attempt; stop at the owner choice before a new finite calculation or a convergence attempt.
reentry_condition: An explicit owner decision on the single state/transfer contract. If approved, freeze a new draft revision with a full enumerator before any calculation, record any state-space completion as such, then perform primary/non-importing independent/hostile verification and possible Lean. Do not mutate this hash-pinned incomplete draft or reclassify older PASS results.
non_claims: No complete v2 finite model or exact move enumerator has been delivered or admitted yet.
No inverse-validity, L1=0, detailed-balance, projection-commutation or B*B=-L theorem for v2.
No refinement, infinite-volume, continuum, Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity, Yang-Mills, mass-gap or TOE conclusion.
The definition gap is not a counterexample to every possible v2 completion and does not revoke the approved Option A root conventions.
